The Milwaukee Wrecking Bar is a robust demolition tool designed for efficient nail pulling, lifting, and prying tasks. Its beveled edge improves leverage and accessibility, making it ideal for renovation projects and general construction work. The dual nail removers efficiently extract fasteners, including nails and staples, without damaging surrounding materials. A reinforced strikeable tongue allows for extra penetration when struck with a hammer, enhancing its utility. Constructed from reinforced, impact-resistant steel with a chrome-plated finish, this pry bar offers durability and corrosion resistance for demanding trade use.
b: Quick & Easy Removal of Nails & Staples
Versatile Tool for Lifting & Prying Tasks
